title: RevisionLab composition
question: Choose the composition to carry the Signal Desk product world.

options.label: Route board
options.thesis: One selected prototype expands into a clear end-to-end operating route.
options.viewport: A dark navigation rail frames one dominant prototype route board and a compact health inspector.
options.risk: The expanded row needs careful responsive compression.

options.label: Traffic table
options.thesis: Every prototype becomes one inspectable route through screens, flows, replay, versions, and access.
options.viewport: A full-width catalogue uses aligned route stations, with one row unfolding into its flow map.
options.risk: High density must remain readable for first-time users.

options.label: Control island
options.thesis: The prototype journey itself owns the canvas, with operations gathered around it.
options.viewport: A large connected four-screen journey dominates the first viewport, with a right inspector and action dock.
options.risk: The dashboard must inherit this focus without turning every screen into a diagram.
